subject: Next steps — FinLine onramp, auth & rerank plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finline.co>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinLine onboarding — high-level recap and immediate asks

Hi Alex — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and what we need to move to a short technical onramp window (sandbox -> prod):

1) Integration surface: SDK + REST
   - We recommend starting with our Python SDK (v1.4) in sandbox for auth and structured-output examples.
2) Auth: API keys for sandbox; for prod you mentioned requiring either IP allowlist + mTLS or a VPC private endpoint. Please confirm which you prefer.
3) Routing & egress: need to confirm whether requests will originate from your cloud (GCP us-east1) or our private peering. If using your VPC, we’ll provide an endpoint address to allowlist.
4) Structured output & tool-calling: we’ll provide a sample schema and an SDK helper for tool attachments/rerank hooks.
5) Embeddings & reranker: we proposed an initial pipeline (512-d embeddings, cosine, then 1:4 rerank). Will you be using an existing embedding store or need us to recommend a managed option?
6) Network details we need from you: public egress IP ranges (for allowlist), preferred DNS domain for endpoint resolving, and whether you require mutual TLS with client certs.

Attachments: finline-postcall-notes.pdf (summary + screenshots).

Suggested next steps:
- Procurement: confirm billing contact + NDA (if any) — Alex to loop procurement.
- NetOps: share CIDR/IPs and maintenance window for firewall changes.
- Technical follow-up: 30–45m call next week to finalize auth mode and handover to NetOps.

I’ll schedule a working session — please tell me who should be on the call on your side.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
---
Attachment: finline-postcall-notes.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finline.co>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finline.co, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@finline.co>
Date: 2027-05-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLine onboarding — high-level recap and immediate asks

Thanks Camila — good summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement looped in (procurement@finline.co) to start T&C.
- NetOps/Platform: Priya (cc) will own the network questions.
- For prod security we are leaning toward mTLS + IP allowlist (we require client certs for third-party services).
- Embedding store: we currently use an internal vector DB (hosted) and would prefer to keep embeddings there; we’ll want a secure path for large uploads and periodic snapshotting.

I’ll ask Priya to send CIDR ranges and a contact for the firewall change window. Please keep the sandbox flow simple — API key + token rotation is fine.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Product Integrations | FinLine
alex.morgan@finline.co

On Mon, May 25, 2027 at 3:12 PM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finline.co>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-26T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLine onboarding — technical checklist and sandbox steps

Hi team — putting together a concise technical checklist so Priya/NetOps can action quickly. Camila, feel free to paste into the follow-up.

Technical checklist (action required from FinLine in bold):
- Sandbox: SDK v1.4 usage sample + example structured-output schema (we’ll provide a repo link).
- Auth (sandbox): API key; rotate keys every 30 days (recommended).
- Auth (prod): confirm one of the following:
   a) VPC Private Endpoint (preferred for highest isolation) — we will provide a private A record and endpoint IPs.
   b) Public endpoint + IP allowlist + mTLS client certs — you supply client certs or we can issue through your CA.
- IP allowlist: provide CIDR(s) that will be allowed outbound from your netops or that we should allow inbound on our public endpoint.
- DNS: provide the desired host name (e.g., api-finline.redwood-internal.example) or confirm you want our default resolvable name.
- Ports: 443 only; if you require proxying please confirm details.
- Embeddings: we support direct upload via secure multipart or S3 presigned POST to a managed bucket. Which do you prefer?
- Reranker: please identify a sample query set (10–25 items) for initial eval.

Deliverables from Redwood:
- redwood-vpc-onramp-guide.pdf (network config snippet and sample firewall rules)
- SDK examples for structured output + tool calling
- Sample cert request template for mTLS (CSR + CA chain guidance)

Camila — I’ll volunteer to run the NetOps call if Priya proposes times.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@finline.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finline.co>, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLine onboarding — network details and windows

Ben / Camila — thanks, attaching our inventory and required windows. Key items from NetOps: 

- Outbound/proxy egress (our side): 34.198.10.0/24, 34.198.11.0/24 (production egress through our proxy cluster).
- Inbound allowlist (we can open firewall rules to Redwood public endpoints if you provide IPs).
- Preferred deploy model: we prefer a VPC Private Endpoint if you support an endpoint in GCP us-east1; otherwise, public + mTLS.
- mTLS: We can provide client certs signed by our internal CA; attach is netops-inventory.csv with environment tags.
- Maintenance window for changes: Tue/Wed 00:00–03:00 UTC (preferred).

Attachment: netops-inventory.csv (text/csv, 15KB)

Can you provide a short note with the following so our firewall team can process the request?
1) IP addresses for the endpoint(s) (or ranges) to allow inbound.
2) Certificate format you require for client certs (PEM preferred).
3) A reference doc for the DNS name or host we should expect to resolve.

Thanks,
Priya Gupta
Platform Engineering — NetOps | FinLine
priya.gupta@finline.co
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@finline.co>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finline.co>
Date: 2027-05-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLine onboarding — scheduling NetOps handoff + owners

Thanks Priya — appreciate the inventory. Quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood: 

1) We can provision either a GCP us-east1 private endpoint or a public endpoint with mTLS. I’ll enumerate owner-side impact below.
2) For your firewall ticket, please reference this inbound allowlist from Redwood for the public endpoint: 52.23.145.8/32, 52.23.145.9/32 (we will confirm final numbers before the window). We prefer PEM-encoded client certs for mTLS; CA bundle accepted as PEM.
3) Deliverables we’ll share by EOD: redwood-vpc-onramp-guide.pdf, CSR template + mTLS cert instructions, SDK structured-output examples, small sample rerank dataset.

Owners & actions:
- Redwood network lead (Ben Carter) — provide final endpoint IPs and test certs.
- FinLine NetOps (Priya) — open firewall ticket and confirm maintenance window slot.
- Camila (Sales) — coordinate procurement & meeting notice.
- Monica (Redwood) — run the technical handoff and capture any acceptance criteria.

Proposed working session: Thu 2027-05-30 16:00–16:45 UTC — join link: https://meet.example.com/redwood-finline-onramp. Please confirm or propose alternate times.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Technical Program Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
